title: Skew-Symmetric Matrix (hat) and vee
hints: Write out a × b component-wise and read off which entry of a multiplies which entry of b.
Row 0 is [0, -z, y]. Fill a Matrix3d with the comma initializer `S << ...;`.
vee just reads the three independent entries back: (S(2,1), S(0,2), S(1,0)). Averaging with the mirrored entries is more robust to noise.
